title: CE31214: Construction And Building Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Historical development; Basic concept and characteristics,
Properties of typical composite materials; Elastic behavior of unidirectional
lamina and multidirectional laminate, Stress-strain relationship, Strength and
failure; Hygrothermal effect; End-use performance properties of structural
composites; Low density rigid foam materials, Sandwich construction, design
methods; Structural forms of composites and their use in the construction
industry; Analysis and design of composite structures; Numerical design and
detailing.
